test_cases.title: OBU does not open a second session with the same RBC while the first is being established
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A session with RBC-A is currently being established (setup in progress).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger for a new session with RBC-A (e.g., driver selects 'Start' or receives an order from trackside to contact RBC-A).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is capable of detecting the state of the ongoing session establishment.

steps.action: Initiate a new communication session request with RBC-A while the initial session with RBC-A is still in the 'establishing' state.
steps.expected: The OBU does not initiate a new, separate session establishment process with RBC-A. The original establishment process continues or is handled according to standard abort/retry logic, but no duplicate concurrent session attempt is made.

test_cases.title: OBU does not open a second session with the same RBC while an active session exists
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has an established and active communication session with RBC-A. No Termination of Communication Session message has been sent to RBC-A.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger for a new session with RBC-A (e.g., manual level change to Level 2 or driver selects RBC contact info).

steps.action: Trigger a new communication session request with RBC-A while the existing session is active.
steps.expected: The OBU does not open a further communication session with RBC-A. The existing session remains active and is not duplicated.

test_cases.title: OBU terminates existing session with different RBC to establish new session
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has an established communication session with RBC-A. The OBU is capable of handling only one GSM-R session at a time (or the new order requires it).
test_cases.test_inputs: Order from trackside to establish a session with RBC-B.
test_cases.assumptions: RBC-A and RBC-B are different entities.

steps.action: Receive an order to establish a communication session with RBC-B while a session with RBC-A is active.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a Termination of Communication Session message to RBC-A.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's behavior after terminating the session with RBC-A.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the establishment of a new communication session with RBC-B.

test_cases.title: OBU maintains existing session when receiving order for Accepting RBC in transition
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has an established communication session with RBC-A (currently supervising). The OBU is capable of handling multiple sessions or the specific exception applies.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC transition order containing an embedded order to establish a session with RBC-B (Accepting RBC).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is not forced to terminate the existing session due to hardware limitations (i.e., it can handle the transition without dropping the current session immediately, or the exception clause applies).

steps.action: Receive an RBC transition order that includes an instruction to establish a session with the Accepting RBC (RBC-B).
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT terminate the existing session with RBC-A immediately upon receipt of the order.

steps.action: Observe the session state with RBC-A.
steps.expected: The session with RBC-A remains active until the specific conditions for termination are met (e.g., when the train actually transitions or per specific protocol timing), ensuring continuity.

test_cases.title: OBU evaluates balise info validity based on crossing direction in SL mode
test_cases.preconditions: Engine is in Sleeping (SL) mode. Train orientation is set to 'Forward'.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group data containing information valid only for 'Reverse' direction (opposite to train orientation) and information valid for 'Forward' direction.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is physically crossing the balise group in the 'Reverse' direction relative to the track definition, or the test simulates a crossing where the 'crossing direction' differs from the 'train orientation' setting.

steps.action: Simulate the train crossing a balise group in the 'Reverse' direction while in SL mode.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the validity of the received information against the 'Reverse' crossing direction.

steps.action: Check if information valid only for 'Forward' (opposite to crossing) is processed.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the information valid only for the 'Forward' direction.

steps.action: Check if information valid for 'Reverse' (crossing direction) is processed.
steps.expected: The OBU takes into account the information valid for the 'Reverse' direction.

test_cases.title: OBU evaluates balise info validity based on crossing direction in PS mode
test_cases.preconditions: Engine is in Passive Shunting (PS) mode. Train orientation is set to 'Forward'.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group data containing information valid only for 'Reverse' direction.
test_cases.assumptions: The train crosses the balise group in the 'Reverse' direction.

steps.action: Simulate the train crossing a balise group in the 'Reverse' direction while in PS mode.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the validity of the received information against the 'Reverse' crossing direction, not the 'Forward' train orientation.

steps.action: Verify processing of information valid for the crossing direction.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts and processes the information valid for the 'Reverse' direction.

test_cases.title: OBU keeps applying old MA request parameters until new ones are received
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. Current MA request parameters: Repetition = No, Triggering Time = 10s. An MA request was sent 5 seconds ago.
test_cases.test_inputs: No new MA request parameters received yet.

steps.action: Wait until 10 seconds have passed since the last MA request.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send a new MA request because the 'Repetition' parameter is 'No' and the triggering time criteria for repetition are not met (or simply, it adheres to the 'No repetition' rule).

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from RBC: Repetition = Yes, Interval = 5s.
steps.expected: The OBU updates its internal parameters to the new values.

test_cases.title: OBU sends immediate MA request if time since last request exceeds new repetition period
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. Current MA request parameters: Repetition = No. An MA request was sent 10 seconds ago.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA request parameters from RBC: Repetition = Yes, Interval = 5s.

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters with a repetition interval of 5 seconds.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the time since the last MA request (10s) with the new repetition interval (5s).

steps.action: Observe OBU behavior immediately after receiving the new parameters.
steps.expected: Since 10s >= 5s, the OBU sends an MA request immediately.

test_cases.title: OBU does not define SvL while supervising a Limit of Authority
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is supervising a Movement Authority with a Limit of Authority (LOA) where the target speed is above zero.
test_cases.test_inputs: Track data containing potential SvL candidates (e.g., end of overlap, Danger Point).

steps.action: Simulate the train approaching a location that would normally be a Supervised Location (SvL) candidate, such as the end of an overlap.
steps.expected: The OBU does not define this location as an SvL.

steps.action: Check the internal state of SvL candidates.
steps.expected: None of the SvL candidates (end of overlap, Danger Point, end of End Section) are active as SvLs while the LOA is being supervised.

test_cases.title: Level 1 signalling speed restriction remains valid until new restriction received
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1. A signalling related speed restriction of 50 km/h is currently active.
test_cases.test_inputs: No new signalling related speed restriction received.

steps.action: Drive the train for a period without receiving any new signalling related speed restriction.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to apply the 50 km/h speed restriction.

steps.action: Receive a new signalling related speed restriction of 80 km/h.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the 50 km/h restriction with the 80 km/h restriction immediately upon receipt.

test_cases.title: Level 1 signalling speed restriction remains valid after switching to Level 2 until MA accepted
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1 with an active signalling related speed restriction of 50 km/h.
test_cases.test_inputs: Transition to Level 2. Level 2 MA is not yet accepted.

steps.action: Switch the OBU from Level 1 to Level 2.
steps.expected: The OBU remains in a state where the Level 1 signalling related speed restriction (50 km/h) is still valid.

steps.action: Verify the speed limit applied by the OBU before a Level 2 MA is accepted.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to enforce the 50 km/h speed restriction.

steps.action: Accept a Level 2 MA from the RBC.
steps.expected: The Level 1 signalling related speed restriction is no longer the primary constraint (replaced by Level 2 MA logic).

test_cases.title: Maximum Train Speed is handled as a Static Speed Restriction category
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is configured with a Maximum Train Speed (MTS) of 200 km/h.
test_cases.test_inputs: Track data with no other speed restrictions.

steps.action: Drive the train in a section with no other speed restrictions.
steps.expected: The OBU limits the train speed to 200 km/h, treating the MTS as a static speed restriction.

steps.action: Attempt to exceed 200 km/h.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates braking to prevent the train from exceeding the Maximum Train Speed.

test_cases.title: Initial state 'no speed restriction' allows full permitted braking distance
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where no speed restriction has been computed from trackside data (initial state).
test_cases.test_inputs: No trackside speed restriction data received.

steps.action: Drive the train in the initial state before any speed restriction is computed.
steps.expected: The OBU does not apply any permitted-braking-distance limit based on speed restrictions. The train speed is limited only by the Maximum Train Speed and other non-restriction factors.

test_cases.title: Resuming initial state 'no speed restriction' removes braking distance limits
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is currently applying a speed restriction of 100 km/h.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order to resume the initial state (no speed restriction).

steps.action: Receive a trackside order to resume the initial state for speed restrictions.
steps.expected: The OBU clears the 100 km/h speed restriction.

steps.action: Observe the train speed supervision.
steps.expected: No permitted-braking-distance limit based on speed restrictions constrains the train speed. The train can accelerate up to the Maximum Train Speed.

test_cases.title: Immediate reconnection attempt after safe radio connection loss
test_cases.preconditions: An established communication session exists. The safe radio connection was previously set up via GSM-R (or the specific active radio system).
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated loss of safe radio connection signal from EURORADIO.
test_cases.assumptions: The radio system used for the initial connection is available and functional for reconnection.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection via EURORADIO indication.
steps.expected: The OBU immediately initiates a request to set up a new safe radio connection using the same radio system as before.

steps.action: Allow the reconnection process to complete successfully.
steps.expected: A new safe radio connection is established, and the communication session is maintained.

test_cases.title: Repeated reconnection attempts until success
test_cases.preconditions: An established communication session exists. The safe radio connection is lost.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated loss of safe radio connection. First reconnection attempt fails. Second reconnection attempt succeeds.
test_cases.assumptions: The session has not been terminated and the train has not passed the RIU termination location.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the first reconnection attempt.

steps.action: Simulate a failure of the first reconnection attempt.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates a second reconnection attempt immediately after the failure indication.

steps.action: Simulate a success of the second reconnection attempt.
steps.expected: The safe radio connection is re-established, and the OBU stops further reconnection attempts.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when session is terminated
test_cases.preconditions: An established communication session exists. The safe radio connection is lost. The defined time for maintaining the session (per A.3.1) has elapsed without reconnection.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated loss of safe radio connection. Reconnection attempts fail continuously until the session termination timeout.
test_cases.assumptions: The session termination logic is triggered by the timeout defined in A.3.1.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection and ensure reconnection attempts fail.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to repeat reconnection attempts.

steps.action: Wait for the defined session maintenance time to elapse.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the session as terminated and stops the reconnection attempts.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when train passes RIU termination location
test_cases.preconditions: An established communication session exists. The safe radio connection is lost. An RIU order to terminate the communication session at a specific location is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated loss of safe radio connection. Train movement simulation passing the specified RIU location.
test_cases.assumptions: The RIU order contains a valid location for session termination.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection and ensure reconnection attempts are ongoing.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to repeat reconnection attempts.

steps.action: Simulate the train passing the location indicated in the RIU order.
steps.expected: The OBU stops the reconnection attempts as the termination condition is met.

test_cases.title: Termination initiated by explicit trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established between the OBU and the RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: A 'Termination of communication session' order message from the RBC.

steps.action: Send a 'Termination of communication session' order from the RBC to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination procedure by sending a 'Termination of communication session' message to the RBC.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's radio traffic after sending the termination message.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send any further messages until an acknowledgement is received or the timeout/repetition logic is triggered.

test_cases.title: Termination initiated by internal condition without trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established. The OBU is configured to trigger termination upon a specific internal condition (e.g., loss of valid movement authority or specific mode transition defined in SUBSET-026).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger the internal termination condition (e.g., simulate the condition defined in SUBSET-026 that requires session termination).
test_cases.assumptions: The specific internal condition is identifiable and triggerable in the test environment.

steps.action: Trigger the internal condition that requires termination of the communication session, ensuring no explicit trackside order is sent.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination procedure by sending a 'Termination of communication session' message to the RBC.

test_cases.title: No termination initiated without valid trigger
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established. No trackside order is received. No internal termination condition is met.
test_cases.test_inputs: None (idle state).

steps.action: Wait for a duration longer than the fixed waiting time without sending any trackside orders or triggering internal conditions.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send a 'Termination of communication session' message. The session remains active.

test_cases.title: Repetition of Termination message upon missing acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has initiated termination and sent the first 'Termination of communication session' message. The RBC is configured to not send an acknowledgement.
test_cases.test_inputs: None (RBC silence).
test_cases.assumptions: The fixed waiting time T_wait is known from Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time T_wait after the first 'Termination of communication session' message is sent.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a second 'Termination of communication session' message.

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time T_wait after the second message is sent.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a third 'Termination of communication session' message.

test_cases.title: Session considered terminated after max repetitions without acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in the process of terminating a session. The RBC is configured to never send an acknowledgement.
test_cases.test_inputs: None (RBC silence).
test_cases.assumptions: The defined number of repetitions N_max is known from Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: Allow the OBU to repeat the 'Termination of communication session' message until the defined number of repetitions N_max is reached.
steps.expected: The OBU has sent the termination message N_max times.

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time T_wait after the last (N_max-th) sending of the termination message.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the communication session terminated. No further termination messages are sent. The OBU state reflects that the session is closed.

test_cases.title: No repetition if acknowledgement is received within waiting time
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has initiated termination and sent the first 'Termination of communication session' message.
test_cases.test_inputs: An 'Acknowledgement of termination of communication session' message from the RBC.

steps.action: Send an 'Acknowledgement of termination of communication session' from the RBC within the fixed waiting time T_wait.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the acknowledgement.

steps.action: Wait for a duration longer than the fixed waiting time T_wait.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send any further 'Termination of communication session' messages.

test_cases.title: OBU evaluates two-direction data when orientation is unknown
test_cases.preconditions: The train orientation cannot be related to the direction of the trackside device.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside message valid for both directions.

steps.action: Transmit a message to the OBU that is valid for both directions, under conditions where the train orientation cannot be related to the trackside device direction.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates and accepts the data. The data is applied to the OBU's state.

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data: Value validity over incremental distance
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has previously received profile data. The train is moving in the nominal direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: A continuous profile data message with two values: Value A (speed 100 km/h) and Value B (speed 80 km/h), with Distance 1 = 100m and Distance 2 = 200m.

steps.action: Transmit the continuous profile data message.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets Value A as valid for the first 100m (Distance 1). The OBU interprets Value B as valid for the next 200m (Distance 2).

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data: Previously received data for first distance
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has previously received a profile value of 120 km/h. The train is moving in the nominal direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: A continuous profile data message with one new value: Value C (speed 60 km/h), with Distance 1 = 50m.

steps.action: Transmit the continuous profile data message.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the previously received data (120 km/h) for the first 50m (Distance 1). The OBU applies Value C (60 km/h) for the distance following Distance 1.

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data: Last value valid for unlimited distance
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is processing continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: A continuous profile data message with one value: Value D (speed 50 km/h), which is not an end-of-profile value.

steps.action: Transmit the continuous profile data message.
steps.expected: The OBU applies Value D (50 km/h) for the unlimited distance following the previous profile segment.

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data: Zero distance value is taken into account
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is processing continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: A continuous profile data message with two values: Value E (speed 100 km/h) and Value F (speed 90 km/h), with Distance 1 = 0m and Distance 2 = 100m.

steps.action: Transmit the continuous profile data message.
steps.expected: The OBU takes Value E into account despite Distance 1 being 0. The OBU applies Value F for the next 100m.

test_cases.title: Location data: Unsigned incremental distances
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has a current location reference.
test_cases.test_inputs: A location data message with two values: Location A and Location B, with Distance 1 = 10m and Distance 2 = 20m.

steps.action: Transmit the location data message.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets Distance 1 as the distance from the previous location reference to Location A. The OBU interprets Distance 2 as the distance from Location A to Location B.

test_cases.title: Location data: Previously received data for first distance
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has previously received location data.
test_cases.test_inputs: A location data message with one new value: Location C, with Distance 1 = 5m.

steps.action: Transmit the location data message.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the previously received location data for the first 5m (Distance 1). The OBU applies Location C for the distance following Distance 1.

test_cases.title: Non-continuous profile data: Overlapping elements
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is processing non-continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Non-continuous profile data with two elements: Element 1 (Value A, Length 100m) and Element 2 (Value B, Length 50m). Distance to start of Element 1 = 0m, Distance to start of Element 2 = 50m.

steps.action: Transmit the non-continuous profile data message.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the data. The OBU recognizes that Element 2 starts at 50m, which is within the length of Element 1 (0-100m), and processes the overlapping elements correctly.

test_cases.title: Non-continuous profile data: Incremental distances between element starts
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is processing non-continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Non-continuous profile data with two elements: Element 1 (Value A, Length 10m) and Element 2 (Value B, Length 10m). Distance to start of Element 1 = 0m, Distance to start of Element 2 = 20m.

steps.action: Transmit the non-continuous profile data message.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets the distance to the start of Element 2 as 20m from the start of Element 1. The OBU applies Value A for the first 10m and Value B for the next 10m starting at 20m.

test_cases.title: Linking information: Distances to announced balise groups
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is processing linking information.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information with two announced balise groups: BG1 and BG2. Distance 1 = 100m, Distance 2 = 50m.

steps.action: Transmit the linking information message.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets Distance 1 as the distance to the first announced balise group (BG1). The OBU interprets Distance 2 as the distance between BG1 and BG2.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Linking consistency is checked.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information containing location accuracy for BG-A. BG-A is received and becomes LRBG.
test_cases.assumptions: The linking information provides a specific location accuracy value (e.g., 10m) for BG-A.

steps.action: Receive linking information specifying location accuracy for Balise Group A.
steps.expected: OBU stores the location accuracy from linking information for BG-A.

steps.action: Receive Balise Group A such that it becomes the LRBG.
steps.expected: OBU uses the location accuracy value from the linking information for BG-A in position calculations.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from National Value when linking is unavailable
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. No linking information has determined the location accuracy for BG-B. A National Value for location accuracy is configured.
test_cases.test_inputs: BG-B is received and becomes LRBG. No prior linking data for BG-B.
test_cases.assumptions: The National Value for location accuracy is 20m.

steps.action: Receive Balise Group B such that it becomes the LRBG without prior linking information determining its accuracy.
steps.expected: OBU uses the configured National Value (20m) as the location accuracy for BG-B.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from Default Value when no National Value applies
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. No linking information has determined the location accuracy for BG-C. No National Value is applicable for the current location.
test_cases.test_inputs: BG-C is received and becomes LRBG. No prior linking data for BG-C.
test_cases.assumptions: The Default Value for location accuracy is 30m.

steps.action: Receive Balise Group C such that it becomes the LRBG without prior linking information and without an applicable National Value.
steps.expected: OBU uses the Default Value (30m) as the location accuracy for BG-C.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy not updated upon further linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has determined location accuracy for BG-D as 10m from initial linking information. BG-D is the current LRBG.
test_cases.test_inputs: New linking information is received specifying a different location accuracy (e.g., 15m) for BG-D.

steps.action: Receive new linking information that specifies a different location accuracy for BG-D.
steps.expected: OBU retains the original location accuracy (10m) for BG-D and does not update it to 15m.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy not updated when linking is no longer checked
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has determined location accuracy for BG-E as 20m from National Value. Linking consistency checking is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking consistency checking is disabled. A new National Value becomes applicable.

steps.action: Disable linking consistency checking.
steps.expected: OBU continues to use the previously determined location accuracy (20m) for BG-E.

steps.action: Update configuration so that a new National Value (e.g., 25m) becomes applicable.
steps.expected: OBU does not update the location accuracy for BG-E; it remains 20m.

test_cases.title: Confidence interval delimitation with standard parameters
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Train is moving. Reference BG has location accuracy 10m. Odometer over-reading is 5m, under-reading is 5m. No consist length uncertainty applies.
test_cases.test_inputs: Estimated front end position is 1000m from reference BG.
test_cases.assumptions: Consist length uncertainty is not applicable in this scenario.

steps.action: Calculate the min safe front end position.
steps.expected: Min safe front end is calculated as Estimated Position - (Location Accuracy + Under-reading) = 1000 - (10 + 5) = 985m.

steps.action: Calculate the max safe front end position.
steps.expected: Max safe front end is calculated as Estimated Position + (Location Accuracy + Over-reading) = 1000 + (10 + 5) = 1015m.

test_cases.title: SOLR selection with linking consistency checked
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is checked. BG-1 is received. BG-2 is received and is announced in linking information.
test_cases.test_inputs: Sequence of balise group receptions: BG-1, then BG-2 (announced in linking info).

steps.action: Receive BG-1.
steps.expected: SOLR is set to BG-1.

steps.action: Receive BG-2, which is announced in linking information.
steps.expected: SOLR is updated to BG-2.

test_cases.title: SOLR selection without linking consistency checked
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is NOT checked. BG-3 is received. BG-4 is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: Sequence of balise group receptions: BG-3, then BG-4.

steps.action: Receive BG-3.
steps.expected: SOLR is set to BG-3.

steps.action: Receive BG-4.
steps.expected: SOLR is updated to BG-4 (last received balise group).

test_cases.title: Linking replacement rule applied before SOLR update
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Linking consistency is checked. Current SOLR is BG-Old.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information is received that references a new balise group BG-New as the reference.
test_cases.assumptions: The linking replacement rule dictates that the new reference takes precedence.

steps.action: Receive linking information that establishes BG-New as the reference for linking.
steps.expected: OBU applies the linking replacement rule first, then updates the SOLR to BG-New.

test_cases.title: Processing location based information into min, estimated, max items
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A location based information item (e.g., a signal) is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location based information with a single distance value.
test_cases.assumptions: The information type requires processing into min, estimated, and max items per SUBSET-026 Table 2a.

steps.action: Receive location based information.
steps.expected: OBU processes the information into three distinct location items: 'min', 'estimated', and 'max'.

steps.action: Evaluate the information using the 'estimated' location item.
steps.expected: The evaluation logic uses the 'estimated' item as specified by the associated clause in Table 2a.

test_cases.title: Relocation of location items to new SOLR using linking distance
test_cases.preconditions: Current SOLR is BG-A. A location item is referenced to BG-B. Linking information provides the distance between BG-B and BG-A. BG-A becomes the new SOLR (or remains SOLR and BG-B is evaluated).
test_cases.test_inputs: Location item distance to BG-B is 100m. Linking distance from BG-B to BG-A is 50m. Location item type is 'estimated'.
test_cases.assumptions: Linking distance is available and known.

steps.action: Evaluate the location item referenced to BG-B while BG-A is the SOLR.
steps.expected: OBU relocates the item to SOLR (BG-A) by subtracting the linking distance: 100m - 50m = 50m.

test_cases.title: Relocation of 'min' location item with location accuracy adjustment
test_cases.preconditions: Current SOLR is BG-A. A 'min' location item is referenced to BG-B. Last relocation was performed per clause 3.6.4.2.5 c) towards a BG not received earlier than the reference BG. Linking distance between BG-B and BG-A is 50m. Location accuracy of BG-B is 10m.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location item distance to BG-B is 100m.

steps.action: Evaluate the 'min' location item referenced to BG-B.
steps.expected: OBU calculates the relocation distance as linking distance (50m) diminished by twice the location accuracy of FRBG (2 * 10m = 20m). Relocation distance = 50m - 20m = 30m. New distance = 100m - 30m = 70m.

test_cases.title: Position report on reaching standstill
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where position reporting is active. The train is moving. Position report parameters are configured such that no periodic report is due at the moment of standstill.

steps.action: Decelerate the train until it reaches standstill (speed = 0).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

steps.action: Verify the content of the sent position report.
steps.expected: The position report reflects the event of reaching standstill (e.g., current speed is 0, position is updated).

test_cases.title: Position report on leaving standstill
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where position reporting is active. The train is at standstill. A position report for reaching standstill has already been sent.

steps.action: Accelerate the train from standstill to a non-zero speed.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

steps.action: Verify the content of the sent position report.
steps.expected: The position report reflects the event of leaving standstill (e.g., current speed > 0).

test_cases.title: Position report on mode change
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a valid ETCS mode (e.g., Full Supervision). Position reporting is active.

steps.action: Trigger a mode change (e.g., from Full Supervision to Shunting or Standstill).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

steps.action: Verify the content of the sent position report.
steps.expected: The position report reflects the new mode.

test_cases.title: Position report on level change
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is operating in Level 2. Position reporting is active.

steps.action: Trigger a level change (e.g., from Level 2 to Level 1 or Level 0).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC before or during the transition, as required by the event list.

steps.action: Verify the content of the sent position report.
steps.expected: The position report reflects the level change event.

test_cases.title: Position report on successful session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is not connected to an RBC. The RBC is available and ready to establish a session.

steps.action: Initiate the establishment of a communication session with the RBC.
steps.expected: The session is successfully established.

steps.action: Monitor OBU messages to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC immediately after the session is successfully established.

test_cases.title: Position report on passing LRBG compliant balise group without stored parameters
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where position reporting is active. No position report parameters are stored on-board. The train is approaching an LRBG compliant balise group.

steps.action: Drive the train over the LRBG compliant balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

steps.action: Verify the content of the sent position report.
steps.expected: The position report reflects the position derived from the LRBG.

test_cases.title: Position report on RBC/RBC border crossing (min safe rear end)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is connected to RBC-A. The train is approaching the border with RBC-B. The train's min safe rear end is approaching the border.

steps.action: Drive the train such that its min safe rear end crosses the RBC/RBC border.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

steps.action: Verify the content of the sent position report.
steps.expected: The position report reflects the crossing of the RBC/RBC border.

test_cases.title: Report train integrity status as 'No integrity information'
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is connected to an RBC. The train integrity status is 'No integrity information'.

steps.action: Trigger a position report (e.g., by reaching standstill).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the train integrity information in the position report.
steps.expected: The train integrity status is reported as 'No integrity information'. No confirmed train length is included in the report.

test_cases.title: Report train integrity status as 'Confirmed by driver' with length
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is connected to an RBC. The driver has confirmed train integrity. Valid train length and position are available.

steps.action: Trigger a position report (e.g., by reaching standstill).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the train integrity information in the position report.
steps.expected: The train integrity status is reported as 'Confirmed by driver'. The confirmed train length is included in the report.

test_cases.title: Report train integrity status as 'Confirmed by external source' with length
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is connected to an RBC. Train integrity is confirmed by an external source. Valid train length and position are available.

steps.action: Trigger a position report (e.g., by reaching standstill).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the train integrity information in the position report.
steps.expected: The train integrity status is reported as 'Confirmed by external source'. The confirmed train length is included in the report.

test_cases.title: Report train integrity status as 'Lost' without length
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is connected to an RBC. Train integrity is lost (e.g., due to a fault or driver action).

steps.action: Trigger a position report (e.g., by reaching standstill).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the train integrity information in the position report.
steps.expected: The train integrity status is reported as 'Lost'. No confirmed train length is included in the report.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'No integrity information' to 'Confirmed by driver'
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is connected to an RBC. Current integrity status is 'No integrity information'. Valid train length and position are available.

steps.action: Driver confirms train integrity.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the internal integrity status to 'Confirmed by driver'.

steps.action: Trigger a position report.
steps.expected: The position report contains the integrity status 'Confirmed by driver' and the confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'Confirmed by driver' to 'Lost'
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is connected to an RBC. Current integrity status is 'Confirmed by driver'.

steps.action: Simulate a loss of train integrity (e.g., via a fault injection or driver action).
steps.expected: The OBU updates the internal integrity status to 'Lost'.

steps.action: Trigger a position report.
steps.expected: The position report contains the integrity status 'Lost' and no confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'Confirmed by external source' to 'Confirmed by driver'
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is connected to an RBC. Current integrity status is 'Confirmed by external source'.

steps.action: Driver confirms train integrity.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the internal integrity status to 'Confirmed by driver'.

steps.action: Trigger a position report.
steps.expected: The position report contains the integrity status 'Confirmed by driver' and the confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Initial status after session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is not connected to an RBC.

steps.action: Establish a communication session with the RBC.
steps.expected: The session is successfully established.

steps.action: Trigger the first position report after session establishment.
steps.expected: The position report contains the integrity status 'No integrity information'.

test_cases.title: Geographical position display upon driver request
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where geographical position data is available and valid. The geographical position display is currently inactive.
test_cases.test_inputs: Driver request to display geographical position.

steps.action: Verify that the geographical position is not displayed on the HMI.
steps.expected: The geographical position is not visible on the driver display.

steps.action: The driver issues a request to display the geographical position.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the geographical position of the estimated front end of the train in relation to the track kilometre.

test_cases.title: Stopping geographical position display upon driver request
test_cases.preconditions: The geographical position is currently being displayed on the HMI.
test_cases.test_inputs: Driver request to stop displaying geographical position.

steps.action: Verify that the geographical position is currently displayed on the HMI.
steps.expected: The geographical position is visible on the driver display.

steps.action: The driver issues a request to stop the display of the geographical position.
steps.expected: The OBU stops displaying the geographical position. The position information is no longer visible on the driver display.

test_cases.title: Geographical position calculation includes distance travelled from reference
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has received valid geographical position information from a balise group. The train has moved a known distance from the reference balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: Known distance travelled from the geographical reference location (e.g., 100 meters).
test_cases.assumptions: The track kilometre reference value and offset are known and valid. The counting direction is consistent with the train's movement.

steps.action: Record the track kilometre reference value and the offset from the reference balise group to the track kilometre reference.
steps.expected: The OBU stores the reference data correctly.

steps.action: Move the train a specific distance (e.g., 100 meters) from the geographical reference location in the direction of the track kilometre counting.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the current geographical position by adding the distance travelled (100 meters) to the track kilometre reference value (adjusted for offset and direction).

steps.action: Request the display of the geographical position.
steps.expected: The displayed track kilometre value reflects the reference value plus the distance travelled from the reference location.

test_cases.title: Roll-away distance supervision start calculation
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where Roll Away Protection supervision can be started (e.g., Standstill). The train is stationary at a known location not associated with a balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: National/Default Value for Roll Away distance (e.g., 10 m).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a diagnostic interface or log to observe the calculated remaining distance and the start location.

steps.action: Start the Roll Away Protection supervision.
steps.expected: The OBU records the current location as the start point. The remaining distance is calculated as the full National/Default Value (e.g., 10 m) minus the estimated distance travelled (0 m).

steps.action: Move the train forward by 2 meters (simulated or actual movement).
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance to 8 meters (10 m - 2 m).

steps.action: Move the train forward by another 3 meters.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance to 5 meters (10 m - 5 m).

test_cases.title: Post Trip reversing distance supervision start calculation
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Post Trip mode. The train is stationary.
test_cases.test_inputs: National/Default Value for reversing distance in Post Trip mode (e.g., 5 m).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows entry into Post Trip mode for testing purposes.

steps.action: Initiate the reversing supervision in Post Trip mode.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining reversing distance as the full National/Default Value (e.g., 5 m).

steps.action: Move the train in the reverse direction by 1 meter.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining reversing distance to 4 meters.

test_cases.title: Staff Responsible distance supervision start calculation
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Staff Responsible (SR) mode. A valid SR distance is set (e.g., 100 m).
test_cases.test_inputs: SR distance value: 100 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides access to the virtual train front position parameters (estimated, min safe, max safe).

steps.action: Start or re-start the Staff Responsible distance supervision.
steps.expected: The OBU creates a virtual train front position. The remaining distance from the estimated front end is 100 m. The remaining distance from the max safe front end is 100 m minus odometer under-reading (0 m initially). The remaining distance from the min safe front end is 100 m plus odometer over-reading (0 m initially).

steps.action: Move the train forward by 10 meters.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance from the estimated front end to 90 m. The max and min safe front end distances are updated according to the odometer error values.

test_cases.title: Supervision uses estimated distance travelled from start location
test_cases.preconditions: Roll Away Protection supervision is active. The train has moved 5 meters from the start location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Roll Away distance: 10 m. Current estimated distance travelled: 5 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU's position estimation is accurate for the test scenario.

steps.action: Check the remaining distance calculation.
steps.expected: The remaining distance is calculated as 10 m (supervised distance) - 5 m (estimated distance travelled) = 5 m.

steps.action: Move the train back towards the start location by 2 meters.
steps.expected: The estimated distance travelled away from the start location decreases to 3 m. The remaining distance is updated to 7 m (10 m - 3 m).

test_cases.title: Virtual train front position with odometer under-reading
test_cases.preconditions: Staff Responsible mode is active. Odometer under-reading is simulated to be 2 m.
test_cases.test_inputs: SR distance: 100 m. Odometer under-reading: 2 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows simulation of odometer under-reading for testing.

steps.action: Start the Staff Responsible supervision.
steps.expected: The remaining distance from the max safe front end is calculated as 100 m - 0 m (travelled) - 2 m (under-reading) = 98 m.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 10 meters.
steps.expected: The remaining distance from the max safe front end is updated to 88 m (100 m - 10 m - 2 m).

test_cases.title: Virtual train front position with odometer over-reading
test_cases.preconditions: Staff Responsible mode is active. Odometer over-reading is simulated to be 3 m.
test_cases.test_inputs: SR distance: 100 m. Odometer over-reading: 3 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows simulation of odometer over-reading for testing.

steps.action: Start the Staff Responsible supervision.
steps.expected: The remaining distance from the min safe front end is calculated as 100 m - 0 m (travelled) + 3 m (over-reading) = 103 m.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 10 meters.
steps.expected: The remaining distance from the min safe front end is updated to 93 m (100 m - 10 m + 3 m).

test_cases.title: Supervision re-start after Override in Staff Responsible mode
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Staff Responsible mode. The train has moved 20 m from the initial SR start point. The current SR distance is 100 m.
test_cases.test_inputs: New SR distance: 150 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows updating the SR distance via RBC or driver input.

steps.action: Update the Staff Responsible distance to 150 m.
steps.expected: The OBU deletes the previous virtual train position and creates a new one. The remaining distance from the estimated front end is reset to 150 m.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 5 meters.
steps.expected: The remaining distance is updated to 145 m (150 m - 5 m).

test_cases.title: Supervision of zero distance to former EOA/LOA after Override
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Standstill or Post Trip mode. Override is triggered. No valid train position is stored on-board.
test_cases.test_inputs: Override function triggered.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can be configured to have no valid train position for testing.

steps.action: Trigger the Override function.
steps.expected: The OBU starts supervision of a zero distance to the former EOA/LOA. The virtual train front position is created at the current location.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 1 meter.
steps.expected: The remaining distance to the former EOA/LOA is calculated as 0 m - 1 m = -1 m, indicating the train has passed the former EOA/LOA.

test_cases.title: MA kabul edilmemesi: SSP/gradient MA uzunluğunu tam kapsamıyor (Non-infill)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Level 2 modunda çalışmaktadır. Mevcut MA ve SSP/gradient verileri yüklenmiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni bir MA mesajı (Non-infill), SSP/gradient verileri MA'nın tam uzunluğunu (tren ön ucundan denetlenen konuma kadar) kapsamayacak şekilde hazırlanmıştır.
test_cases.assumptions: Tren ön ucu konumu ve denetlenen konum (Supervised Location) bilinen değerlerdir. SSP/gradient verisi, MA'nın sonundan önce bitmektedir.

steps.action: SSP ve gradient verileri MA'nın tam uzunluğunu kapsamayan yeni bir MA mesajı OBU'ya gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA'yı ve ilişkili mode profile'ı (varsa) reddeder. Mevcut MA ve mode profile geçerli kalmaya devam eder.

steps.action: OBU'nun MA kabul durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Yeni MA'nın kabul edilmediği, mevcut MA'nın hala aktif olduğu gözlemlenir.

test_cases.title: MA kabul edilmemesi: SSP/gradient MA uzunluğunu tam kapsamıyor (Infill)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Level 2 modunda çalışmaktadır. Infill MA senaryosu için gerekli koşullar sağlanmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni bir Infill MA mesajı, SSP/gradient verileri infill konum referansından denetlenen konuma kadar olan tam uzunluğu kapsamayacak şekilde hazırlanmıştır.
test_cases.assumptions: Infill konum referansı ve denetlenen konum bilinen değerlerdir. SSP/gradient verisi, denetlenen konuma ulaşmadan bitmektedir.

steps.action: SSP ve gradient verileri infill MA'nın tam uzunluğunu kapsamayan yeni bir Infill MA mesajı OBU'ya gönderilir.

steps.action: Verify the stored location-based information.
steps.expected: The location-based information is updated according to the normal replacement rules, not deleted.

steps.expected: All previously stored location-based information is deleted.

test_cases.title: MA request includes all applicable reasons
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session with the RBC is established. The OBU is configured to send MA requests.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated conditions to trigger multiple MA request reasons simultaneously (e.g., driver selects 'Start' and a Section timer is about to expire).
test_cases.assumptions: The RBC is set up to log or echo back the received MA request reasons for verification.

steps.action: Simulate the driver selecting 'Start' on the DMI.
steps.expected: The OBU registers the reason 'Start selected by driver' as applicable.

steps.action: Simulate the train position such that the time before the Section timer expires is reached (based on RBC parameters).
steps.expected: The OBU registers the reason 'Time before a Section timer/LOA speed timer expires reached' as applicable.

steps.action: Trigger the MA request transmission (e.g., by reaching the repetition period or immediate trigger).
steps.expected: The MA request sent to the RBC contains both 'Start selected by driver' and 'Time before a Section timer/LOA speed timer expires reached' in the reason field.

test_cases.title: MA request includes only applicable reasons
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session with the RBC is established. No other MA request reasons are currently active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated condition to trigger a single MA request reason (e.g., track description deletion).

steps.action: Simulate a track description deletion event that is not in situations a, b, f, or k of Appendix A.3.4.
steps.expected: The OBU registers the reason 'Track description deletion' as applicable.

steps.action: Trigger the MA request transmission.
steps.expected: The MA request sent to the RBC contains only the reason 'Track description deletion' and does not include any other reasons.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by perturbation location criterion
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. MA request parameters from RBC are received, defining a time before perturbation location. A perturbation location is known to the OBU.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed set to warning speed. Train position simulated to approach the calculated trigger location.
test_cases.assumptions: The trigger location is calculated as the point where the train, running at warning speed, will reach the perturbation location after the defined time.

steps.action: Simulate the train front moving towards the calculated trigger location for the perturbation criterion.
steps.expected: No MA request is sent while the train front is before the trigger location.

steps.action: Simulate the train front passing the calculated trigger location.
steps.expected: The OBU triggers and sends an MA request to the RBC with the reason 'Time before reaching the perturbation location reached'.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by Section timer criterion
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. MA request parameters from RBC are received, defining a time before Section timer expiration. A Section timer is active and supervised.
test_cases.test_inputs: Section timer value simulated to count down.

steps.action: Simulate the Section timer counting down until the defined time before expiration is reached.
steps.expected: No MA request is sent while the time before expiration is greater than the defined parameter.

steps.action: Simulate the moment when the defined time before Section timer expiration is reached.
steps.expected: The OBU triggers and sends an MA request to the RBC with the reason 'Time before a Section timer/LOA speed timer expires reached'.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by LOA speed timer criterion
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. MA request parameters from RBC are received, defining a time before LOA speed timer expiration. A LOA speed timer is active and supervised.
test_cases.test_inputs: LOA speed timer value simulated to count down.

steps.action: Simulate the LOA speed timer counting down until the defined time before expiration is reached.
steps.expected: No MA request is sent while the time before expiration is greater than the defined parameter.

steps.action: Simulate the moment when the defined time before LOA speed timer expiration is reached.
steps.expected: The OBU triggers and sends an MA request to the RBC with the reason 'Time before a Section timer/LOA speed timer expires reached'.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by track description deletion
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session with the RBC is established. Track description is loaded.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated track description deletion event corresponding to a situation in Appendix A.3.4 that is not a, b, f, or k (e.g., situation c).

steps.action: Simulate a track description deletion event for a situation not excluded (e.g., situation c of A.3.4).
steps.expected: The OBU detects the deletion and triggers an MA request to the RBC with the reason 'Track description deletion'.

test_cases.title: No MA request for excluded track description deletion situations
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session with the RBC is established. Track description is loaded.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated track description deletion event corresponding to situation 'a' of Appendix A.3.4.

steps.action: Simulate a track description deletion event for situation 'a' of Appendix A.3.4.
steps.expected: The OBU does not trigger an MA request to the RBC with the reason 'Track description deletion'.

test_cases.title: End Section timer start upon passing start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A valid MA with an End Section timer start location ahead of the train is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA containing End Section timer start location and time-out value.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is moving towards the End Section timer start location.

steps.action: Move the train such that its max safe front end is just before the End Section timer start location.
steps.expected: The End Section timer is not started (value is 0 or inactive).

steps.action: Move the train such that its max safe front end passes the End Section timer start location.
steps.expected: The End Section timer starts counting.

test_cases.title: End Section timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: End Section timer is running. The train is moving within the End Section. The MA contains a non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority (LOA).
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with LOA and non-zero target speed. End Section time-out value set to a short duration for testing.
test_cases.assumptions: The train does not pass the End Section timer stop location before the timeout.

steps.action: Wait until the End Section timer value exceeds the time-out value given by trackside.
steps.expected: The EOA/LOA is withdrawn to the current position of the train. The location based information listed in Appendix A.3.4 is deleted. The non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority is set to zero.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer start in Level 2
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is operating in Level 2. A new MA message is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA message with a specific time stamp.
test_cases.assumptions: The system clock is synchronized with the trackside time stamp.

steps.action: Receive the MA message in Level 2.
steps.expected: The LOA speed timer starts at the value of the time stamp of the message containing the MA.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer start in Level 1
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is operating in Level 1. The train is approaching a balise group that provides the MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group with variable information containing the MA.
test_cases.assumptions: The train passes the first balise of the group.

steps.action: Pass the first encountered balise of the balise group giving the MA.
steps.expected: The LOA speed timer starts at the moment of passage over the first encountered balise.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: LOA speed timer is running. The MA contains a LOA with a non-zero speed.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with LOA speed. LOA speed time-out value set to a short duration for testing.
test_cases.assumptions: No other timer events occur before the LOA speed timeout.

steps.action: Wait until the LOA speed timer value exceeds the time-out value received from trackside.
steps.expected: The speed associated with the LOA is set to zero. The LOA becomes an EOA. The Supervised Location is defined as per SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.5. The location based information listed in Appendix A.3.4 is deleted accordingly.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start upon passing start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A valid MA with an Overlap timer start location ahead of the train is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA containing Overlap timer start location and a finite time-out value.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is moving towards the Overlap timer start location.

steps.action: Move the train such that its max safe front end is just before the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer is not started.

steps.action: Move the train such that its max safe front end passes the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer starts counting.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start with infinite time-out value
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A valid MA with an Overlap timer start location ahead of the train is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA containing Overlap timer start location and time-out value 'infinite'.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is moving towards the Overlap timer start location.

steps.action: Move the train such that its max safe front end passes the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer is considered as started, even though the time-out value is 'infinite'.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: Overlap timer is running. The MA contains an Overlap with a release speed and a non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with Overlap, release speed, and non-zero target speed at EOA. Overlap time-out value set to a short duration for testing.
test_cases.assumptions: The train does not come to a standstill before the timeout.

steps.action: Wait until the Overlap timer value exceeds the time-out value given by trackside.
steps.expected: The overlap information is deleted. The release speed associated with the Overlap is deleted. The Supervised Location is redetermined per SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.5. The location based information listed in Appendix A.3.4 is deleted. The non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority is set to zero.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer expiration upon train standstill
test_cases.preconditions: Overlap timer is running. The train is moving.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with Overlap timer. Train braking command to stop.
test_cases.assumptions: The train comes to a complete standstill after the Overlap timer has been started.

steps.action: Bring the train to a standstill after the Overlap timer has been started.
steps.expected: The OBU considers that the Overlap timer value became greater than its time-out value. The consequences defined for Overlap time-out in SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.2 are applied (overlap deleted, release speed deleted, SvL redetermined, target speed at EOA set to zero).

test_cases.title: Overlap timer expiration upon receiving new MA with rear start location
test_cases.preconditions: No Overlap timer is running. The OBU receives a new MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA with an Overlap timer start location in rear of the max safe front end of the train.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is moving and the new MA is valid.

steps.action: Receive a new MA with an Overlap timer start location in rear of the max safe front end of the train while no Overlap timer is running.
steps.expected: The OBU considers that the Overlap timer value became greater than its time-out value. The consequences defined in SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.2 are applied (overlap deleted, release speed deleted, SvL redetermined, target speed at EOA set to zero).

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with valid Overlap

test_cases.preconditions: The Overlap has timed out and been deleted. A Danger Point exists. An End Section exists.

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location (SvL) determined by the OBU after Overlap timeout.

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with no Overlap and no Danger Point
test_cases.preconditions: No Overlap exists (or it has timed out). No Danger Point exists. An End Section exists.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with no Overlap, no Danger Point, and End Section.
test_cases.assumptions: The Overlap timer is not running or has timed out.

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location (SvL) determined by the OBU.
steps.expected: The SvL is the end of the End Section.

test_cases.title: Replacement of MA data from RBC (Non-infill)

steps.action: Inspect the OBU's internal MA data structure.
steps.expected: All data of the previous MA (speed profiles, end location, section timers) are replaced by the data from the new RBC MA. No residual data from the previous MA remains.

steps.action: Inspect the OBU's internal MA data structure.
steps.expected: All data of the previous MA are replaced by the new data from the balise group. The MA now reflects the new signal aspect and speed restrictions.

test_cases.title: MA Shortening when SvL replaces LOA
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising an MA ending with an LOA (Limit of Authority). The train is within the LOA.

test_cases.title: OBU reads next main signal balise group and ignores subsequent loop infill
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 operation. The OBU has read a main signal balise group (BG1) indicating the next main signal balise group (BG2). The loop infill unit is active and transmitting infill information for BG2.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train moves from BG1 towards BG2. Loop infill data for BG2 is transmitted. OBU reads BG2.
test_cases.assumptions: The loop infill unit continues to transmit data for a short period after the OBU reads BG2 to simulate the 'further' information condition.

steps.action: Move the train so that the OBU reads the next main signal balise group (BG2).
steps.expected: The OBU processes the data from BG2 and updates its internal state to reflect the new main signal.

steps.action: Ensure the loop infill unit transmits additional infill information related to BG2 after the OBU has read BG2.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the received loop infill information. The OBU's internal state and movement authority remain consistent with the data from BG2 and are not modified by the loop infill data.

test_cases.title: OBU detects missed next main signal balise group and ignores subsequent loop infill
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 operation. The OBU has read a main signal balise group (BG1) indicating the next main signal balise group (BG2). The loop infill unit is active and transmitting infill information for BG2. The train is positioned such that it will pass BG2 without reading it (e.g., due to a fault or specific test setup).
test_cases.test_inputs: Train moves past BG2 without reading it. Loop infill data for BG2 is transmitted after the miss is detected.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU has a mechanism to detect that the expected balise group was missed (e.g., based on distance traveled or timeout).

steps.action: Move the train past the location of the next main signal balise group (BG2) without the OBU reading it, triggering the 'missed' detection logic.
steps.expected: The OBU detects that the next main signal balise group was missed and initiates the appropriate safety reaction (e.g., braking or state change as per other requirements, but specifically here we focus on the infill handling).

steps.action: Ensure the loop infill unit transmits additional infill information related to BG2 after the OBU has detected the miss.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the received loop infill information. The OBU does not use the loop infill data to update its movement authority or signal state.

test_cases.title: PBD girdilerinden birinin değişmesiyle yeniden hesaplama

test_cases.title: PBD hesabında tahmini ivmenin sıfır olarak ayarlanması
